Maya Chen: noticed a ~4.8k embed shortfall for ACME during last night's replay window. billing shows fewer acked rows than ingest. anyone on call?
Sam Torres: which job/shard?
Maya Chen: job=job_20241113_0205, primary shard=shard-7, spill to shard-3 during GC. logs show many ack write failures with unique constraint errors.
Priya Patel: that sounds like duplicate event_ids from replay. reconciler used plain INSERT historically. can we run a safe upsert to populate ack_ledger?
Sam Torres: yep. plan: extract failing event_ids and run `INSERT INTO ack_ledger (customer_id,event_id,acked_at) VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT (customer_id,event_id) DO NOTHING;` will add missing rows without altering existing ones. will test in staging then prod. ETA 45m.
Maya Chen: finance: can you accept a recount if we fix ledger within 24h? otherwise we'll need a provisional hold.
finance-bot: note  ACME invoice 2024-11-ACME-10 is disputed. please attach runbook R002 for audit.
Priya Patel: after upsert, re-run `SELECT count(*) FROM billing_view WHERE customer='ACME' AND window='2024-11-13T02:00-03:00'` and compare to ingest metric.
Sam Torres: upsert done in prod. 4,823 rows added, 0 errors.
Maya Chen: recount matches ingest within 1-2 rows. closing dispute and marking invoice adjusted. thanks.
finance-bot: automated note  reconciler service patched with upsert in release 2024.11.13-hotfix1.
